article.title: Testamentary guardian.
article.content: A father, whatever his age may be, may by will appoint a guardian or guardians for his child during minority.

Section 60 · Part VI · Chapter II · page 28 of the Act

A father, whatever his age may be, may by will appoint a guardian or guardians for his child during minority.
